dedupe_keys.name: asim activated sludge simulation program eawag

description: ASIM (Activated Sludge SIMulation Program) is a program for simulating activated sludge wastewater treatment, produced by the Process Engineering department of Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology. Version 5 is distributed through an order form on Eawag's site, and the teaching and research version is available free of charge. Coverage is any activated sludge plant a user configures. Access is free for teaching and research through the order form; other uses are ordered from Eawag. Caveats: the page read gives no technical documentation, supported platforms or licence terms, so these must be requested from Eawag. Simulation uses: activated sludge process design and operation studies for wastewater treatment plants. Related records: the IWA benchmark simulation models (model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models).
